title: The Red River Delta in 3 days
summary: Hoan Kiem and Hoa Lo, then a day at Trang An. This is the short stay, not Ha Long and not the mountains.

days.title: Day 1 — Hoan Kiem
days.body: Walk the Old Quarter and the path around Hoan Kiem Lake. The lake path is free. Ngoc Son Temple, on the island, charges its own ticket.

days.title: Day 2 — Hoa Lo
days.body: Walk the cells at Hoa Lo, at 1 Hoa Lo, south of the lake. An adult ticket is 50,000 VND.

days.title: Day 3 — Trang An
days.body: Go to Ninh Binh for the Trang An sampan and come back. An adult over 1.3 m is 300,000 đồng. How long the boats take is Check on arrival.

seoTitle: 3 days in the Red River Delta
seoDescription: A short Hanoi stay: Hoan Kiem, Hoa Lo, and a day at Trang An.
